The KCGG 
142 is a numerical 3 plase over current and earth fault relay with 3 stages of 
phases and earth fault protection I>/I0>, I>>/10>> & 
I>>>/I0>>>, which can be used for 3 phase differential protection or restricted 
earth fault (ref) protection

The 
output relay that is to trip the circuit breakers must be allocated in the relay 
masks t > a ; for 
t > b and t > c

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Khaled 
Saad Ahmed, accepted by 
eng. Fatma Elzhraa Mohamed: 
general manager, approved by 
eng. Abdel Maneam Rabeay: head sector of El Nakra Power Station, and 
certified by eng. Mohamed Kamel 
Ahmed: UE zone quality control general director and MPIS coordinator.

A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety 
 helmet ... etc

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current 
 circuits for test current injection.
Outage arrangement must be done.
Secondary injection test set type CTR 233
Test leads
Multi-meter

Connect test leads between the current terminals on the relay (21,22) 
 phase a and the current terminals on the test set type CTR 233 (phase a)
RL0: I > / 10 > start

Record 
 the value on the test sheet

Repeat the same steps 1,2,3,4 for phases B, C
 on terminal (23,24) for phase B, and (25,26) for phase C
Repeat step no. 1 in current setting test.

Connect the relay time delayed out put contacts number (42-44) to the timer 
 contacts of the test set type CTR 233

Reaper test set type CTR 233 for measuring time delay.
 (I normal = 0.5 I setting, I fault = 2 I setting) & apply the setting current 
 in cell (0605 I >) to the KCGG and note the time 
 displayed when the timer stops.

Prepare test set type CTR 233 for measuring time delay & inject.
 into the A phase and note 
 the time displayed when the timer stop.

Check the operating time recorded by the timer is within the range 
 shown in table 9

Repeat the same steps no 1,2,3,4 for 
 phases B, C on terminal (23,24) for phase B, and (25,26) for phase C
Set up the circuit breaker for trip test.
Repeat step No 1 in current setting test.

Inject current into the relay until the circuit breaker trips at the time 
 belayed setting.
Close the circuit breaker again.

Repeat the same steps 1,2,3 for remaining phase B&C on terminal (23,24) for 
 phase B and (25,26) for phase C
